conventions.frames: 0-based FILM frame index at 60 fps (not reel frames). Frame f is shown at f/60 s.
conventions.inherited: fadeIn, fadeOut, hardOut, track, draw, text swaps, positions and easing follow capture/titles/reel-titles.cues.json conventions exactly; sceneAt() in capture/titles/titles.ts resolves every event here unchanged.
conventions.templates: Text tokens in {braces} on the route board ({player}, {rival}, {separationDeg}, {peakKm}, {minKm}, {samples}) are filled at render time from the game code itself (capture/youtube/routeDiagram.ts), never typed by hand. anchorTo places a label at a computed diagram point.
conventions.boards: boards[] holds the film-only vector primitives (phone outline, route diagram, workflow connectors, capture ticks). They draw under the record text and obey the same in/out conventions.

tempo.rule: Every event starts on an 18-frame grid line; entrances on the 9-frame unit; exits end on a picture cut or clear of a flash/dip.

shadow.lift: two drop shadows under record text only: (0,0) 0.6px and (0,1px) 6px, as the reel. Never a glow.

record.note: The reel's record block scaled ~1.22x for YouTube phone playback (primary 44 px, as the loop's 30 px at 1280).
